carousel.subtitle: Comprehensive Patent and Trademark registration across MENA.

jurisdictions.brief: Full IP protection available including Patents, Trademarks, Designs, and Copyrights under Law No. 82/2002.
jurisdictions.details: Egypt possesses a robust legal framework for Intellectual Property. Trademark protection lasts for 10 years and is renewable. Patent protection is valid for 20 years from the filing date. Legal translation and POA notarization/legalization are mandatory for non-resident filers.

jurisdictions.brief: Overseen by the UAE Ministry of Economy. Comprehensive international trademark registration via Madrid Protocol.
jurisdictions.details: The UAE offers modern digital filing systems for Patents, Trademarks, and Industrial Designs. Member of the Paris Convention and PCT. Trademark protection lasts 10 years. Accelerated examination programs available for technology patents.

jurisdictions.brief: Managed via SAIP (Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property). Fast-track registration for regional & global filers.
jurisdictions.details: Saudi Arabia enforces strict enforcement laws through SAIP. Trademarks follow the Hijri calendar system (approx 10 Hijri years). GCC Patent Office procedures and international PCT filings are widely processed with expedited examination options.

jurisdictions.brief: Handled by the Intellectual Property Rights Protection Department at Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
jurisdictions.details: Protection covers Trademarks, Patents, and Copyrights. Smooth electronic clearance processes. Trademark protection is granted for 10 years with multi-class filing restrictions based on local administrative guidelines.

jurisdictions.brief: Managed by the National Intellectual Property Office at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry & Investment Promotion.
jurisdictions.details: Oman provides streamlined IP protection under Paris Convention, PCT, and Madrid Protocol. Trademarks are granted protection for 10 years and patents for 20 years from the filing date.

jurisdictions.brief: Overseen by the Directorate of Wireless Licensing and Frequency & IP Rights under Ministry of Industry and Commerce.
jurisdictions.details: Bahrain offers strong IP protection laws supporting international treaties including Madrid Protocol and PCT. Trademarks valid for 10 years, renewable indefinitely.

jurisdictions.brief: Managed by the Trademarks and Patents Department under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
jurisdictions.details: Covers full service for registration and renewal of Trademarks and Patent prosecution. Local legal representation is required for foreign applications with legalized Power of Attorney.

jurisdictions.brief: Handled by the Industrial Property Protection Directorate under Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply.
jurisdictions.details: Jordan offers strong patent enforcement laws under the TRIPS agreement and US-Jordan FTA provisions. Trademark protection spans 10 years, renewable for equal terms.

jurisdictions.brief: Managed by INAPI (National Algerian Institute of Industrial Property).
jurisdictions.details: Algeria provides industrial property protection for Trademarks, Patents, and Industrial Designs. Member of Paris Convention, PCT, and Madrid System (Agreement & Protocol).

jurisdictions.brief: Handled by OMPIC (Office Marocain de la Propriété Industrielle et Commerciale).
jurisdictions.details: Morocco is an active regional hub for IP protection in North Africa. Provides comprehensive online registration for Trademarks and Patents under the Madrid System and PCT.

jurisdictions.brief: Overseen by INNORPI (National Institute for Standardization and Industrial Property).
jurisdictions.details: Tunisia offers legal protection for Trademarks, Patents, and Designs under international agreements including PCT and Madrid Protocol with standard 10-year renewable trademark terms.
